newsitem.title: INDIA: India's Wockhardt July-Oct turnover up.
newsitem.headline: India's Wockhardt July-Oct turnover up.

text.p: Indian pharmaceuticals maker Wockhardt Ltd's turnover for the period July to October 1996 was 938 million rupees, up 36 percent compared to the year-ago period, its chairman told a shareholders meeting on Friday.
Chairman Habil Khorakiwala told the meeting the firm's exports were 155 million rupees, showing a 66 percent rise over the year ago performance.

He said Wockhardt formed a new joint venture styled Wockhardt Rhein Biopharm to manufacture Hepatitis B vaccine at a new factory. The company will be jointly owned by Wockhardt and Rhein Biopharm of Germany, he said.
"The total investment by this joint venture will exceed 500 million rupees," he said.
